passages.provision_quote: a public school that receives funds under such Act shall obtain parental consent before changing a covered student's-- (1) gender markers, pronouns, or preferred name on any school form
passages.note: Consent covers changes on school forms (narrower than staff use of names/pronouns) and the bill adds a separate curriculum section; shows the parental-permission side only.

rows.reasoning: At the federal level only the person's own words can seat a chair on this topic, and every source here is a record: Yea votes on H.R. 5 (118th) and H.R. 2616 (119th), which require parental consent before changing a child's pronouns or preferred name on school forms. No statement by Steil is in the sources, so no passage survives to support "Require parental permission before staff use a different name or pronouns" or any other rung.
